sourceName: FHWA HPMS 2023, plus PennDOT roadway volumes for Lancaster County
note: Most places are FHWA HPMS sections with annual average daily traffic and a posted speed. Lancaster County, Pennsylvania replaces that sample with PennDOT open data: RMS state-route segments (CUR_AADT) joined to posted speed (roadway admin) and shoulder width in feet (roadway shoulder), plus the Pennsylvania local-road inventory (EST_AVERAGE_DAILY_TRAFFIC, road name, and speed or shoulder when the record includes them). County code 36. Geometry is simplified.
